context.zh: 萇遣其將軍王破虜略地秦州，楊定及破虜戰于清水之格奴阪，大敗之。
context.idiomatic: Yao Chang's Wang Polu raided Qinzhou until Yang Ding shattered him at Genu Slope by Qingshui.
context.literal: Chang sent his general Wang Polu to seize territory in Qinzhou; Yang Ding and Polu fought at Genu Slope on the Qingshui, and Ding inflicted a great defeat on him.
